title: Kinetic motion reel in code
summary: Turn a product or mascot into a fast-cut Swiss-poster motion reel that plays right in your browser.
brief: Build a 14-second, 13-cut Swiss-editorial kinetic motion reel in a single web page for my product or mascot, with bold condensed typography, a three-panel trick triptych, chromatic motion trails, a perspective grid lock-on and rapid gag cards.

prompts.text: Build a 14-second, 13-cut Swiss-editorial kinetic motion design reel as a single self-contained web page using plain HTML, CSS and Canvas 2D JavaScript, for the product or mascot I name (or a cute chibi vinyl-toy dog riding a red bicycle if I do not name one). Use a warm paper cream (#EFECE3), ink black (#151515), vermilion red (#D93829) and deep teal (#2A7A70) poster palette with subtle print grain, bold condensed grotesque headlines, ruler ticks and spring-eased transitions. Choreograph 13 fast cuts across 14 seconds: (1) red circle letter-by-letter title slam with progress bar, (2) circular porthole eye close-up exploding into geometric confetti, (3) charcoal title skid with flying debris, (4) three-panel vertical silhouette triptych, (5) rotating circular typography burst into a deadpan red close-up, (6) diagonal red stripe with squash-and-stretch word hop, (7) teal diagonal ramp with a 4-layer chromatic motion trail and 0 to 360 degree counter, (8) four rapid full-bleed typographic beat cuts, (9) dark 3D perspective wireframe grid with red targeting reticle and PASS 100/100 stamp, (10) rapid version smash cards with exploding triangles and a giant rolling wheel wipe, (11) four humorous REJECTED candidate cards followed by the hero landing, (12) concentric perspective orbital rings cutting to a giant deadpan staredown, and (13) a certified poster lockup with a rolling parade. Support click or spacebar to pause and R to replay. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in the browser when done, check that it plays smoothly, and ask me before installing or loading anything.
